name: Manara
summary: A square minaret rises from warm stone: a copper shaft, a blue stepped crown, and one quiet opening.
why: The broad square stages recall Maghrebi prayer architecture. A single generous doorway keeps the mark calm and readable, while the compact silhouette gives it a grounded presence.
risk: The simplified crown can also suggest a historic tower. The app name helps establish its prayer-time purpose.
reasonToChoose: A clear architectural identity with a Tunisian and Maghrebi character.
